title: About FAIR DAO
subtitle: A decentralized autonomous organization built on the principles of fairness, transparency, and community governance.

features.title: Fair Governance
features.description: Our decision-making process ensures every member has a voice proportionate to their contribution to the community.

features.title: Full Transparency
features.description: All transactions, decisions, and operations are recorded on the blockchain, completely visible to everyone.

features.title: Community Driven
features.description: The direction and development of FAIR DAO is entirely determined by its community members.
